strings.근래에 엘 아노르 산맥 중 특정 지역에 여러 가지 문제가 발생하고 있어요: Recently, various problems have been occurring in one part of the Ell Anor Mountains.
Monster attacks are common enough wherever there are mountains, of course...
But this time feels very different.
strings.과거, 베데스다라고 불리며 신비의 지상낙원으로 불렸던 하이엘프들의 영지: Near the high elves' former territory, once called Bethesda and known as a mysterious earthly paradise...
We've received reports of monsters believed to be from the demon realm.
strings.마계 출신의 몬스터라니요? 마계에서 몬스터가 넘어 왔다는 겁니까?: Monsters from the demon realm? You mean they crossed over from there?
I don't know the details either.
The Guild Union and everyone else have their hands full with all sorts of problems right now...
strings.제가 무슨 일을 하면 되나요?: What would you like me to do?
Please go to the area where the problems keep happening, Bethesda. No, I mean...
The place now called Demon Mountain.
We need a thorough investigation of what's happening there.
strings.우리 여관을 자주 방문해 주시던 분들도 그 지역을 지나가다가 실종되는 사: Even some of our regular guests have gone missing while passing through that area.
I'd like to go myself, but my circumstances won't allow it...
strings.제가 알고 있는 분 중, 가장 실력과 명성이 뛰어난 %s 님을 찾게 된: So I turned to you, %s, the most skilled and renowned person I know.
You've resolved so many problems already.
That's true, but I'm still a little scared.
Are you? Even so, I feel that you could handle it...
strings.악마의 산 조사 임무를 믿고 부탁드려도 될까요?: May I entrust you with investigating Demon Mountain?
Then I'll go and take a look.
strings.부탁드릴게요. 안 그래도 요즘 여기저기서 이상한 일들이 계속 일어나고 있: Please do. Strange things keep happening everywhere these days as it is.
Oh, already gone. I was going to mention that it's gotten colder there...
strings.아, 또 이곳에 사람이 오다니. 갤루스가 또다시 결계에 틈을 만들어 당신: Oh, another person has come here. Gallus must have opened another gap in the barrier and lured you inside.
strings.이곳은 위험해요! 늦기 전에 어서 도망치세요!: This place is dangerous! Run, before it's too late!
Once Gallus's army arrives, you won't be able to escape.
He's the demon who turned this place into what you see now.
There's no time to explain at leisure.
strings.잘못하면 죽을 수도 있으니 어서 도망치세요!: You could die if you're not careful, so run!
strings.잠시만요, 설명을 좀 더 해주시겠어요?: Wait. Could you explain a little more?
strings.근래에 여기서 사람이 계속 행방불명 된다는데, 혹시 그 갤루스라는 악마와: People have been going missing here lately. Does it have something to do with that demon, Gallus?
I'm telling you, Gallus is truly dangerous. He's a demon on an entirely different level.
strings.저, 저는 괜찮으니 계속 말씀해주시겠어요?: I-I'm all right. Could you please keep explaining?
strings.…심각한 상황이라는 건 알겠지만, 설명을 들어야 도와드릴 수도 있을 것: ...I understand this is serious, but I need to hear what's happening if I'm going to help.
This is Demon Mountain, right? Where people keep disappearing...
strings.악마의 산이 아닙니다. 갤루스 때문에 그렇게 불리게 된 것 뿐. 원래 이: It isn't Demon Mountain. That's only what people call it because of Gallus. This place was originally Bethesda, protected by a sacred barrier.
strings.그러나 지진으로 여기저기 차원의 틈이 발생하고, 그 안에서 괴물들이 나타: But an earthquake opened dimensional rifts in several places, and monsters emerged from them.
Because of them, everyone in the Green Foliage clan I led... everyone but me... lost their lives.
This beautiful land, which I failed to protect, became a refuge for demons.
Oh... Then the state you're in now...
strings.갤루스가 걸어 놓은 저주입니다. 악마의 저주조차 풀 수 없는 하이엘프 족: It's a curse Gallus placed on me. How shameful, a high elf chieftain who can't even break a demon's curse.
strings.적어도 악마를 상대할 수 있는 힘만큼은 있다 생각했는데…. 갤루스…. 갤: I thought I at least had the strength to face a demon... Gallus... Gallus...
strings.(리시오네가 갤루스의 이름을 중얼거리며 분노한다. 하지만, 그분노를 삭히: (Lisione mutters Gallus's name in fury, then gradually quiets as if swallowing her anger.)
Let me try breaking the ice.
Ice that won't break... This really isn't ordinary ice. It's...
It's no use. It isn't ordinary ice; it was created by a curse...
Please, just run. You may die if you stay here.
After seeing you like this, I can't just turn back.
strings.정말, 당신은 바보군요. 이 모습을 보고 그런 말이 나오나요?: You really are a fool. You see me like this and still say that?
Yes. That's the kind of person I am. So I can't simply leave.
Please tell me everything you know.
I'll say it again... You really are a fool...
strings.당신은 정말 대단한 사람이군요. 산에 가득했던 갤루스의 군대를 단숨에 처: You're truly remarkable. You dealt with Gallus's army, which filled the whole mountain, in no time...
I knew you weren't an ordinary person, but...
Even so, it's still dangerous. Please withdraw now.
There you go again. I'm all right.
strings.잔당이 좀 남긴 했지만, 이 정도면 산은 어느 정도 정리된 것 맞죠?: There are a few stragglers left, but the mountain is mostly cleared now, right?
strings.제가 또 어디로 가면 되나요? 제가 뭘 하면 되죠?: Where should I go next? What should I do?
strings.…이후로도 정말 위험할 텐데, 그래도 계속 싸우시겠어요?: ...It will be terribly dangerous from here on too. Will you still keep fighting?
I've already started, so I'll give it a try.
You don't have to feel so burdened by it.
Then I'll tell you. Below us is a place called the Hall of Mysteries.
strings.푸른 초목 일족이 고대신 세레스 여신님께 기도를 하고 모여서 일상을 나누: It's where the Green Foliage clan would pray to the ancient goddess Seres and gather to share their daily lives.
We also studied many kinds of natural phenomena there.
strings.그곳도 이미 갤루스의 군대가 장악했어요. 지금 갤루스의 측근들이 머물고: Gallus's army has taken it over as well. His close subordinates are staying there now.
I'm not entirely sure. They're powerful beings of the demon realm named Rubia and Minerva.
Rubia commands the army, while Minerva destroys her opponents through sheer force...
strings.제가 아는 정보로는 이렇습니다. 둘 다 무섭도록 강한 존재…. 만약이지만: That's what I know. Both are frighteningly strong... But if you could defeat them, then surely Gallus too...
I think they stayed here to gather an army.
There's something I want to ask, Lisione. Did they curse you simply to...
strings.네, 맞아요. 절 저주에 가둔 채 괴롭히려고 한 거죠. 많은 이들이 죽음: Yes. That's right. They trapped me in this curse to torment me. To make me keep watching people walk toward their deaths...
strings.최악이에요. 용서할 수 없어요.정말 악마가 따로 없군요. 아니 진짜 악마: That's horrible. I can't forgive it. They're truly monstrous... Though I suppose they can do it because they really are demons.
I'll go right now and deal with those two in the Hall of Mysteries.
And I'll do everything I can to find a way to break your curse.
Please wait just a little longer. Don't worry. Just a little longer.
Are you all right? The curse seems to have gotten worse while I was away...
...Those two didn't know anything. They were simply followers drawn to Gallus's strength...
That seemed true of both Minerva, the spirit, and Rubia.
strings.악마와 마족이 있는 마계는 일반적인 상식으로는 이해할 수 없는 부분이 많: There are many things in the demon realm, where demons and their kind dwell, that ordinary reasoning can't explain.
In the end, they were probably only expendable tools used because they were needed.
strings.일개 체스 말에 불과한 그들, 자신보다 위에 있는 갤루스의 저주를 풀 수: Mere chess pieces... They wouldn't know how to break a curse cast by Gallus, who stands above them.
I'm all right. I'm simply grateful that you came back...
Thank you for returning safely. Now please go back the way you came. Please.
strings.안 돼요, 리시오네…. 이대로는 안 되겠어요. 서둘러 그 갤루스라는 악마: No, Lisione... I can't leave things like this. I need to defeat that demon Gallus, and quickly.
Where should I go next? Please tell me.
I'll say it once more: you really are a fool. Sigh...
strings.다음은 악마의 협곡이에요. 다른 이름이 있었지만, 기억도 나지 않는 그곳: Next is Demon Canyon. It once had another name, but I can no longer remember it. Gallus and many other demons are there...
strings.대지진 당시 발견된 차원의 틈, 그 속에서 나온 마계의 악마. 그는 자신: A demon from the demon realm emerged through a dimensional rift discovered during the great earthquake. He called himself the Bitter Cold.
strings.그런 건 상관없어요. 제가 갤루스 만나 저주를 풀 수 있는 방법을 찾아볼: That doesn't matter. I'll meet Gallus and find a way to break the curse.
If there's a way to cast it, there must be a way to undo it.
So please wait just a little longer, as you have until now. I'll be back soon.
Urgh... I... To think I would fall like this...
strings.럭스에게 입은 부상이 완전히 회복됐다면 너 같은 녀석에게 이런 모욕을 당: If I'd fully recovered from the wounds Lux gave me, I would never have suffered such humiliation at the hands of someone like you.
strings.그래, 럭스. 너도 럭스를 알고 있나보군. 그래, 그는 마계의 군주로 우: Yes, Lux. So you know him too. He rose to become a lord of the demon realm. There was a time when I served as a legion commander under him.
I intended to gather strength here, return to the demon realm, and take my revenge. Now it's all for nothing.
I even stooped to relying on those fools Minerva and Rubia. And this is how it ends.
strings.(갤루스가 앞에 자신을 바라보고 있는 %s에게 조소를 보여준다.): (Gallus sneers at %s, who stands watching him.)
strings.일개 인간따위에게 패배하다니…. 차라리 럭스에게 패했다면 덜 억울할 것을: Defeated by a mere human... Had I fallen to Lux instead, it would have been less galling...
strings.묻고 싶은 게 있어. 리시오네를 바로 죽이지 않고 저렇게 얼어붙는 저주를: There's something I want to ask. Why did you curse Lisione to freeze like that instead of killing her outright?
strings.그저 괴롭히고 싶어서?: Simply because you wanted to torment her?
strings.뭘 바라는 거지? 뻔한 대답을 듣고 싶은 건가? 그러면 대답해주지: What are you hoping for? Do you want to hear the obvious answer? Then I'll tell you.
strings.산을 감싸고 있던 결계 일부를 해제하면 모험가란 인간들은 자신을 증명하고: When I remove part of the barrier around the mountain, those humans called adventurers enter to prove themselves.
strings.얼어붙은 가련한 여인의 사정을 듣고 나에게 도전하고 도전한다. 하지만,: They hear the plight of the pitiful frozen woman and challenge me, one after another. But they never reach me.
strings.그 여인은 한때 괜찮아 질거란 희망을 품었을 것이다. 그게 절망으로 바뀌: For a time, the woman must have hoped things would improve. The moment that hope turns to despair... the expression on her face is so beautiful.
strings.하하하, 모험가가 죽으면 모든 것을 포기한 여인은 절규하지. 그 슬픔,: Hahaha! When the adventurer dies, the woman who has lost everything cries out. That grief, that agony... It is the finest source of power for demons.
strings.저주는 어떻게 풀 수 있지?: How do I break the curse?
There is no way to break my curse. Once it is cast, that is the end of it.
strings.저 엘프 여자를 도와주고 싶은 감정, 그걸 더 이용하고 싶었는데, 이제: I wanted to make further use of that desire to help the elf woman, but now it's over.
strings.그러니 이대로 그 앞에서 그 여자가 얼어죽는 모습을 보고 절망에 빠져라!: So stand before her, watch her freeze to death, and sink into despair!!
That is my final gift as I die at the hands of a mere human.
strings.(갤루스의 웃음소리가 줄어들면서 그를 지탱하던 몸이 산산조각나버린다.): (As Gallus's laughter fades, the body that sustained him shatters into pieces.)
You've returned safely. I'm all right. So please...
You still say you're all right, even like this...
strings.저보단 당신이 더 걱정됩니다. 선한 마음으로 여기까지 와주신 것만으로 전: I'm more worried about you than myself. I'm content simply knowing that your kind heart brought you this far.
strings.무사히 돌아오셨으니 그것만으로도 감사드릴 뿐입니다. 죽어서도 잊지 못할: I'm grateful just that you've returned safely. I won't forget it, even in death.
strings.미안해요. 제가 할 수 있는 게 없었어요. 제가 조금 더 도움이 되고 싶: I'm sorry. There was nothing I could do. I wanted to be of more help...
Instead, I'll do anything else I can for you.
strings.부탁하고 싶은 게 있나요?: Is there anything you'd like to ask?
It's all right. You've already done so much. I'm content. So...
strings.아, 그러면 하나만 들어주시겠어요?: Ah, then would you grant me just one thing?
strings.별 건 아니에요. 제 마지막 기억이 되어 주세요. 홀로 남아 사라지는 건: It isn't much. Please be my last memory. I truly didn't want to fade away all alone. So...
strings.그러니…. 제 마지막이 쓸쓸하지 않도록 잠깐 곁에 있어주시겠어요?: So... would you stay beside me for a little while, so that my final moments won't be lonely?
strings.제 어릴 적 이야기를 들려드리고 싶어요. 엘프 마을의 평화로웠던 한 때를: I'd like to tell you about my childhood. About a peaceful time in the elf village...
strings.(리시오네의 옆에 앉아 이야기를 듣다보니 베데스다의 오래전 모습이 떠오른: (Sitting beside Lisione and listening to her story, I picture Bethesda as it was long ago.)
strings.정말 아름다운 이야기에요. 그러면 이번엔 제가 여기까지 오게 된 이유를: That's such a beautiful story. This time, I'll tell you why I came all this way. May I? Lisione... Lisione?
Lisione, please... Lisione... Open your eyes. Lisione...
strings.그러니까… 전 이리스를 찾기 위해 모험을 떠났고, 여기서 당신을 만났어요: You see... I set out on an adventure to find Iris, and I met you here. And... and...
strings.그 악마가 그렇게까지 그분을 괴롭혔다는 게 너무 가슴이 아프네요: It breaks my heart that the demon tormented her so cruelly.
I'm sorry I couldn't be of any help...
strings.리시오네는 좋은 곳으로 갔을 거에요. 나중에 기회가 되면 다시 만나러 가: I'm sure Lisione has gone to a better place. When I get the chance, I'll go visit her again.
strings.제가 좀 더 마족과 마계에 아는 게 있었으면, 조금만 더 빨리 갔더라면…: If only I'd known more about demons and the demon realm, if only I'd arrived a little sooner...
You did everything you could, %s. Please don't blame yourself.
I'm sorry. Perhaps I gave you a task that was far too difficult.
No. Please don't blame yourself either, Sera.
strings.(마족하고 관련된 일들이 조금씩 늘어날 것 같은데….): (It feels as though incidents involving demons are going to become more frequent...)
Oh, nothing... I was just thinking again about what happened there.
strings.이제 앞으로 어떻게 해야 할지 조금 고민이 됐었거든요. 해야할 일은 뻔하: I was wondering a little about what I should do from now on. It's obvious what I need to do, but still...
Sigh. I'd better go now. I'll see you later, Sera.
strings.네, 저희는 항상 여기 있으니 나중에 일이 생기면 찾아주세요. 플라티나: Of course. We're always here, so come to us if anything happens. My senior, Platina, said the same thing.
Oh, already gone. Well, keep your spirits up.
